settings.maker_story: I learned amigurumi crochet in Japan, during a stay in Kyoto. Each stitch is placed with the intention that this doll becomes a true companion for life.
settings.maker_message: I hope this doll brings Léa a great deal of gentleness. I placed every stitch thinking of this first companion for life. Take good care of her!
settings.share_text: Send us a photo of Léa with her doll. It will join the gallery of Kwaii families.
